"""Adversarial / degenerate families."""
import json, sys

def out(d): return json.dumps(d, separators=(",", ":"))

def fam():
    cases = []
    # 1. identical commodities saturating capacity exactly
    edges = [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":96},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":96}]
    cases.append(("identical comms exact capacity", {
        "epoch": 1, "node_count": 2, "edges": edges,
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":2,"paths":[[0],[1]],
                         "previous":[8,8]} for _ in range(96)],
        "failed_edges": [], "budget": 98304}))
    # 2. capacity one short
    cases.append(("capacity one short", {
        "epoch": 2, "node_count": 2, "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":191}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":2,"paths":[[0]],
                         "previous":[16]} for _ in range(96)],
        "failed_edges": [], "budget": 98304}))
    # 3. 16 paths, capacities exactly demand/16
    edges = [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4} for _ in range(16)]
    cases.append(("16 paths exact", {
        "epoch": 3, "node_count": 2, "edges": edges,
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":64,
                         "paths":[[i] for i in range(16)],"previous":[1]*16}],
        "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}))
    # 4. huge demand tiny capacity -> ceiling infeasible
    cases.append(("ceiling infeasible", {
        "epoch": 4, "node_count": 2, "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0]],
                         "previous":[16]}], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 98304}))
    # 5. mlu exactly 1
    cases.append(("mlu exactly one", {
        "epoch": 5, "node_count": 2, "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0]],
                         "previous":[16]}], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 98304}))
    # 6. all paths of a commodity failed, positive demand
    cases.append(("all paths failed", {
        "epoch": 6, "node_count": 3,
        "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":4,"paths":[[0,1]],
                         "previous":[16]}], "failed_edges": [0,1], "budget": 98304}))
    # 7. failed path with history -> forced migration
    cases.append(("forced migration tight", {
        "epoch": 7, "node_count": 3,
        "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},
                  {"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":4,"paths":[[0,2],[1,2]],
                         "previous":[8,8]}], "failed_edges": [0], "budget": 2}))
    cases.append(("forced migration short", {
        "epoch": 8, "node_count": 3,
        "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},
                  {"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":4,"paths":[[0,2],[1,2]],
                         "previous":[8,8]}], "failed_edges": [0], "budget": 1}))
    # 8. zero demand with history
    cases.append(("zero demand history", {
        "epoch": 9, "node_count": 2, "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0]],
                         "previous":[16]}], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}))
    # 9. no edges, no commodities
    cases.append(("empty", {"epoch": 10, "node_count": 1, "edges": [],
                            "commodities": [], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}))
    # 10. demand positive, no paths
    cases.append(("no paths positive demand", {
        "epoch": 11, "node_count": 2, "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[],
                         "previous":[]}], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 98304}))
    # 11. migration exactly binding on a fractional split
    cases.append(("fractional budget", {
        "epoch": 12, "node_count": 2,
        "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],
                         "previous":[16,0]}], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 1}))
    # 12. deep chain
    edges = [{"tail":i,"head":i+1,"capacity":1024} for i in range(95)]
    cases.append(("long chain", {
        "epoch": 13, "node_count": 96, "edges": edges,
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":95,"demand":1024,
                         "paths":[[i for i in range(95)]],"previous":[16]}],
        "failed_edges": [], "budget": 98304}))
    # 13. symmetric tie between two parallel edges
    cases.append(("symmetric tie", {
        "epoch": 14, "node_count": 2,
        "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},
                  {"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":12,
                         "paths":[[0],[1],[2],[3]],"previous":[4,4,4,4]}],
        "failed_edges": [], "budget": 98304}))
    # 14. opposite directions sharing nothing
    cases.append(("two directions", {
        "epoch": 15, "node_count": 2,
        "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":2},{"tail":1,"head":0,"capacity":9}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":2,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]},
                        {"source":1,"target":0,"demand":9,"paths":[[1]],"previous":[16]}],
        "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}))
    # 15. budget exactly zero with history that is already feasible
    cases.append(("budget zero feasible", {
        "epoch": 16, "node_count": 2,
        "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],
                         "previous":[8,8]}], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}))
    return cases

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for name, r in fam():
        sys.stdout.write(out(r) + "\n")
PYEOF
